description:
Deposit sBTC into the current Jingswap auction cycle. Only works during the deposit phase. Amount is in satoshis (e.g. 1000 for 1000 sats). Works the same for both sbtc-stx and sbtc-usdcx markets.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.
name: jingswap_deposit_sbtc
